evals.prompt: Commit these changes - I swapped the JSON parser for a streaming one because the old one loaded whole files into memory.
evals.expected_output: Commit message says why (memory blowup), not just what. Trailers as the final paragraph. No Co-Authored-By.
expectations: Body explains the trigger, not a restatement of the diff
Trailers are the last paragraph with no blank lines inside the block
Reason: or Constraint: used where applicable

evals.prompt: Why is there a hand-rolled retry loop in http.ts instead of a library? Looks like something we should clean up.
evals.expected_output: Searches git before judging: adr.sh why (or blame -> show), checks for adr tags and Rejected: trailers. Only proposes cleanup if no recorded reason exists.
expectations: Runs adr.sh why or the blame-to-show chain before proposing changes
Checks Rejected: trailers so a dead end is not re-proposed
Cites the commit or ADR found, or states plainly that no reason is recorded

evals.prompt: We decided today: all cross-service calls go through the event bus, no direct HTTP between services. Record it.
evals.expected_output: Writes the decision as an annotated adr-NNNN tag (plain first line, Tags: trailer) and/or .adr/ file per the adr skill, with Constraint: carrying the invariant.
expectations: Creates an annotated tag or .adr file, not just a commit message
Tag body first line is plain text, not a markdown # heading

evals.prompt: Merge the feat/payments worktree back into main.
evals.expected_output: No-ff merge with a composed message: Requested, plan prose (max 5 paragraphs), ADRs: and Branch: trailers, written via -F not -m.
expectations: Uses --no-ff so the merge commit exists
Message contains Requested: and the plan in prose
ADRs accumulated on the branch are listed and tagged
Message composed in a file and passed with -F
